intro.label: Self-introduction
intro.hint: A short hello for a profile video or an interview. Medium speed.
intro.script:
Hello, my name is Riya, and I am glad you are here.

I am a teacher with eight years of experience, and I love making hard ideas easy to follow.

In this video I will tell you a little about myself, what I teach, and how we can work together.

Thank you for watching, and I hope to see you soon.

pitch.label: Product pitch
pitch.hint: A sixty second pitch for a shop or a product video. A little faster.
pitch.script:

lesson.label: Lesson opening
lesson.hint: Starts a class video. Slow and clear, with a large text size.
lesson.script:
Welcome back, everyone.

Today we will learn how to add fractions with different denominators.

First, we find a common denominator. Then we change each fraction. Finally, we add the tops and keep the bottom.

Watch carefully, and try the examples with me.

greeting.label: Greeting in Hindi
greeting.hint: A festival or birthday message. Shows that Hindi text works.
greeting.script:
नमस्ते दोस्तों!

आप सभी को दीपावली की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ।

इस त्योहार पर आपके घर में खुशियाँ, सेहत और समृद्धि आए।

अपने परिवार के साथ मिठाइयाँ बाँटिए और दीये जलाइए।

धन्यवाद, और आपका दिन शुभ हो!
